phrases.text: Fortnite has a whole new island, and this is a full tour of every place on it, straight from Epic's official map data.
There are 17 places on it: 12 named locations and 5 landmarks.
And it really is new. Not one place from last week's map is still on it.
We'll go clockwise from the north, with real distances between every stop. Save this one for your next drop!
Here's how Epic sums it up in the in-game news.
Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay,
or storm The $.$. Rocky on this mysterious skull-shaped island.
Part one: the 12 named locations.
First up, Loot Lagoon, in the north of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Fortune's Fort and Lantern Landing.
Next stop: Fortune's Fort, about 340 meters to the east.
Next, Fortune's Fort, in the north-east of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Loot Lagoon and Cursed Cavern.
Landmark nearby: Boogie Boat, about 330 meters away.
Next stop: Cursed Cavern, about 500 meters to the south.
Cursed Cavern is near the center of the island.
Its closest neighbors are The $.$. Rocky and Loot Lagoon.
Landmark nearby: The Salty Skull, about 120 meters away.
Next stop: The $.$. Rocky, about 370 meters to the east.
Then The $.$. Rocky, in the east of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Cursed Cavern and Busy Bay.
Epic's news tile says to storm it.
Next stop: Busy Bay, about 400 meters to the south.
After that, Busy Bay, in the south-east of the island.
Its closest neighbors are The $.$. Rocky and Plunder Port.
Landmark nearby: Baratie, about 40 meters away.
Next stop: Plunder Port, about 410 meters to the south-west.
Keep going and you hit Plunder Port, in the south of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Busy Bay and Loguetown.
Landmark nearby: Henry, about 180 meters away.
Next stop: Loguetown, about 420 meters to the north-west.
Next, Loguetown, in the south of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Windmill Village and Plunder Port.
Landmark nearby: Giant's Battlefield, about 220 meters away.
Next stop: Windmill Village, about 360 meters to the west.
Windmill Village is in the south-west of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Loguetown and Arlong Park.
Next stop: Arlong Park, about 510 meters to the north.
Then Arlong Park, in the west of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Lantern Landing and The Chest.
Epic's news tile tells you to explore it.
Next stop: Lantern Landing, about 410 meters to the east.
After that, Lantern Landing, near the center of the island.
Its closest neighbors are The Chest and Loot Lagoon.
Next stop: The Chest, about 340 meters to the north-west.
Keep going and you hit The Chest, in the north-west of the island.
Its closest neighbors are Rubber Resort and Lantern Landing.
Next stop: Rubber Resort, about 250 meters to the north.
Next, Rubber Resort, in the north-west of the island.
Its closest neighbors are The Chest and Loot Lagoon.
Quick one: if you're grabbing anything from the Item Shop, use code BAD. It really helps the channel.
Part two: the 5 landmarks.
First up, Boogie Boat, in the east of the island.
It's about 330 meters from Fortune's Fort, the closest named location.
The Salty Skull is in the south-east of the island.
It's about 120 meters from Cursed Cavern, the closest named location.
Then Baratie, in the south-east of the island.
It sits right at Busy Bay, only about 40 meters away.
Epic's news tile says to sail past Baratie Bay.
After that, Henry, in the south-east of the island.
It's about 180 meters from Plunder Port, the closest named location.
Keep going and you hit Giant's Battlefield, near the center of the island.
It's about 220 meters from Loguetown, the closest named location.
Part three: a quick drop guide, from the same map data.
The two named locations closest together are The Chest and Rubber Resort, about 250 meters apart.
Land at one, and you can rotate into the other fast.
The most isolated named location is Arlong Park. Its closest neighbor is about 410 meters away.
More room to loot before anyone shows up.
The two named locations farthest apart are Busy Bay and Rubber Resort, about 1440 meters across the island.
And the named location closest to the middle of the island is Cursed Cavern.
Quick recap of all the named locations, clockwise from the north.
Loot Lagoon, Fortune's Fort, Cursed Cavern,
The $.$. Rocky, Busy Bay, Plunder Port,
Loguetown, Windmill Village, Arlong Park,
Lantern Landing, The Chest, and Rubber Resort.
That's every place on the new map.
